rollback.method: Restore only this turn changed files from exact pre-task bytes. Remove only this turn new files if full rollback is requested. Never git reset/clean or revert unrelated changes.
featureSwitches: Remove adapter.static to disable static first.
Remove adapter.browserResources to retain all browser resources.
Set rendererConnectionPoolSize: 0 to disable resource pooling.
Set imageMetadataSources: [] to disable metadata supplements.
Remove pathPrefixes when downgrading to an older strict config reader; removing the complete Correio adapter restores its original generic browser scope.
rollback.businessData: Fresh immutable capture snapshots and original assets are retained; do not roll back the business index as part of a code rollback.
